name: Data Science, M.S.
college: College of Engineering and Computing Sciences
source_notes: 30 credits total. Fundamental courses (15) + Thesis track (15) or Non-Thesis/Project track (15). Course-level prereqs (e.g., DTSC 710 requires DTSC 615) cross-referenced from NYIT online catalog descriptions.

requirement_blocks.name: Project Track
requirement_blocks.notes: Non-thesis track only — 3-credit project + 12 credits of electives.

requirement_blocks.name: Electives
requirement_blocks.notes: 9 credits electives for thesis, 12 for non-thesis. Consult with advisor for approved electives.

courses.title: Programming for Data Science
courses.description: Python and R programming for data science.

courses.title: Optimization Methods for Data Science
courses.description: Optimization algorithms — gradient descent, convex optimization, applications.

courses.title: Statistics for Data Science
courses.description: Statistical inference, hypothesis testing, and Bayesian methods.

courses.title: Introduction to Big Data
courses.description: Big data acquisition, storage, management, and analytics on state-of-the-art platforms.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.description: Machine learning concepts and algorithms — classification, clustering, feature selection, Bayesian networks.

courses.title: Data Visualization
courses.description: Data visualization principles, tools, and interactive dashboards.

courses.title: Probability and Stochastic Processes
courses.description: Probability theory, random variables, and stochastic processes.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.description: Neural networks, CNNs, RNNs, unsupervised and reinforcement learning.

courses.title: MS Thesis I
courses.description: First semester of MS thesis research (thesis track).

courses.title: MS Thesis II
courses.description: Second semester of MS thesis — defense.
